Original game art direction for GALE BREAKER: ELEMENTAL CLASH. Premium stylized martial-arts fighting game, hand-painted anime-inspired production concept art, strong graphic silhouettes, elegant cel-shading, expressive angular shape language, detailed but feasible for a small Godot 3D production. Cohesive emerald, crimson, imperial gold, electric cyan elemental identity against deep ink navy. No existing franchise characters, no watermarks. Create a polished landscape art-director presentation board, wide composition, beautiful professional layout and highly readable focal subjects.
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: CHARACTER CONCEPT ART BOARD. Four full-body heroes, each completely visible including feet, equal importance in four spacious vertical columns on warm light-gray concept-paper backdrop with subtle fine ruled annotation lines. Top small heading exactly "GALE BREAKER" and subtitle "CHARACTER EXPLORATION". Bottom labels exactly "KAZE", "IGNIS", "TOPHIA", "VOLT" under corresponding heroes. Under each main full-body pose include a smaller rear-view silhouette and a close-up signature equipment study, 3 color swatches. A sparse, disciplined layout, art is the priority, no paragraphs.
Left KAZE HAYABUSA: lean agile wind shinobi, emerald green layered karate/shinobi vest, charcoal fitted trousers, crimson headband streaming behind, long silver ponytail, lightweight hand wraps and boots, martial stance with open striking palm, translucent emerald wind arc. Balanced Shoto karate and Kenpo personality.
Second IGNIS VULCANA: powerful muscular adult woman, crimson armored Muay Thai and heavy-boxing brawler, broad sturdy fighting stance, huge orange molten piston gauntlets as distinctive equipment, short upward flame-red hair, lava-lit seams, functional protective armor and boots, no sexualized outfit, white-hot sparks.
Third TOPHIA STONEHEART: formidable adult woman earth martial artist, grounded Hung Gar iron-palm stance, imperial amber-and-gold armored robes over dark practical layers, obsidian black twin hair buns, orbiting rectangular stone monolith rings engraved in gold, bronze-jade accents, geometric heavy silhouette.
Right VOLT RAIDEN: nimble androgynous adult cyan rushdown fighter, cropped electric cyan trench coat with split tails, dark aerodynamic trousers, lightning-yellow spiky hair, thin angular visor, dual cyan plasma tonfas visible, acrobatic taekwondo stance. Readable bright cyan lightning traces.
Lighting: restrained studio illumination that preserves local color, subtle shaded ground contact. Design details should support rigging and readable combat poses. No arbitrary new characters or extra elements. This is aspirational final character design, not a screenshot of blocky prototypes.

Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: ENVIRONMENT CONCEPT ART BOARD. Three large panoramic stage paintings stacked vertically on one wide landscape presentation sheet. Each panoramic stage has its own distinct palette, with small material/prop studies in a narrow right-hand column. The central playable fighting lane must remain horizontal, continuous, unobstructed and immediately readable in each view; most architecture behind it, props at edges. No HUD and no large foreground characters. Small heading "GALE BREAKER / ARENAS". Stage labels exactly "ZEPHYR PEAK", "CRIMSON ANVIL", "GOLDEN BAZAAR". Polished painted lighting, atmospheric depth, sharp playable foreground versus softer distant detail.
TOP: ZEPHYR PEAK SANCTUARY. Alpine stone courtyard above a sea of clouds, elegant pagoda and tall crimson torii beams, pink cherry trees, distant blue mountain silhouettes, bright clear blue sky, emerald banners lifted by mountain wind, jade-green wind lanterns and bamboo crates as breakable props. Cool stone-gray fighting platform with subtle gold inlay, wide flat clear lane. Prop studies: hanging wind lantern and bamboo crate.
MIDDLE: CRIMSON ANVIL. Giant black iron anvil stage chained above a lava lake, massive industrial forge architecture, draped heavy chains, basalt outcrops, luminous magma rivers, eclipsed blood-red sun seen through smoke. Strong crimson/orange rim light with dark desaturated iron foreground. Flat stone-and-iron fighting platform, no holes in the fighting lane. Prop studies: molten brazier and cracked basalt pillar.
BOTTOM: GOLDEN ARABIC BAZAAR. Fantasy vaulted grand souk, sandstone pointed arches, brass hanging chandeliers, warm amber shafts of light and drifting spice dust, indigo shadow pockets, intricate tiled borders, folded golden carpets and spice stalls in background, merchants as tiny distant silhouettes. Clear continuous ochre stone fighting lane; brass lanterns and spice crates only at lane edges. Prop studies: brass lantern and spice crate.
Maintain a consistent side-view three-quarter camera appropriate for a 2.5D fighter. The board communicates buildable game-space design rather than disconnected fantasy landscapes. Avoid tiny unreadable technical labels and paragraph text.

Use case: ui-mockup. Asset type: HIGH FIDELITY GAME UI CONCEPT BOARD. A refined landscape presentation with one dominant 16:9 gameplay HUD mockup occupying the left two-thirds, and two smaller complete interface mockups stacked in the right third (character select above, pause/settings below). Faithful, credible PC fighting-game UI with restrained ink-navy translucent panels, ivory legible condensed typography, thin geometric edges, emerald and gold interaction accents, clear spacing. Plenty of playable area remains visible. Functional information hierarchy and consistent reusable components, avoid excessive glowing borders and noisy ornament.
Dominant left mockup: a stylized painted Zephyr mountain courtyard with Kaze in emerald on the left and Ignis in crimson on the right, full bodies in a fighting stance. Top left portrait Kaze, name exactly "KAZE", long emerald health bar with thin delayed-damage red segment; mirrored right portrait Ignis, name exactly "IGNIS", crimson health bar. Center timer exactly "87", round pips and small "ROUND 2". Lower corners clear elemental meters labeled "ELEMENTO" with "75%" and "50%"; a subtle "3 HITS" combo label near the impact, no obstructing giant text. Small bottom tutorial prompts exactly "J SOCO", "K FORTE", "L ELEMENTAL", "U ULTIMATE". HUD should be readable without covering faces, feet, or the center action.
Upper right mockup: character selection titled "ESCOLHA SEU LUTADOR". Four unmistakable portrait cards in one row, labeled "KAZE", "IGNIS", "TOPHIA", "VOLT" with emerald/red/gold/cyan identities. Kaze selected with emerald outline. Small stage thumbnails and a wide clear emerald button exactly "CONFIRMAR". Focus on large cards and clear selected state.
Lower right mockup: pause/settings titled "PAUSA", with obvious highlighted primary button "CONTINUAR", secondary "REINICIAR", "CONTROLES", "VOLTAR AO MENU". Small volume slider labeled "VOLUME". An orderly four-point skills preview strip with elemental icons and selected/unselected states can sit below only if space permits.
Small board title "GALE BREAKER / UI DIRECTION". All visible text must be clean and deliberate; only use the short quoted text, do not invent paragraphs. Deliver a polished concept art mockup, not code, not a photographed screen. Original branding only.

Use case: precise-object-edit. Image 1 is the UI BOARD EDIT TARGET. Image 2 is the approved CHARACTER IDENTITY REFERENCE. Make a targeted continuity correction to the characters in image 1, matching image 2. Preserve image 1's whole landscape UI board composition, background arena, all exact interface text and numbers, health bars, meter bars, panels, buttons, proportions, gold/navy/emerald graphic styling and all UI placements. Do not redesign the layout. Change ONLY the character art in the gameplay illustration and all corresponding portraits: KAZE must match image 2's silver-white long ponytail and crimson headband, emerald layered shinobi vest, charcoal trousers and wraps; keep left gameplay stance. IGNIS must match image 2's adult muscular woman, short spiky flame-red hair, crimson armored brawler outfit with heavy protective details and massive orange molten piston gauntlets; keep right gameplay stance, no bare male torso and no long-haired male interpretation. Both health-bar portraits and selection portraits must use the same corrected identities. TOPHIA's selection portrait must match image 2's adult woman with obsidian twin buns and imperial gold armored robes. VOLT's portrait must match image 2's lightning-yellow spiky hair, cyan visor, cyan/white futuristic coat, no silver hair. Maintain excellent illustrative quality and natural hands. No other changes. This is the final coherent UI concept board for the same game.
